facts.text: I want you to act as an AI writing tutor.
I will provide you with a writer who needs help improving their writing.
My first request is to run a sentiment analysis on a provided text.
I asked for possible motives in the sentiment analysis.
I asked not to use the words positive or negative.
I provided a passage that includes compliments about a woman’s facial beauty and picture.
I provided a passage that expresses a desire to find someone to share dreams and ambition with.
I provided a passage that describes wanting a relationship that values independence and interdependence.
I provided a passage that says the relationship may evolve into something more or not.
I provided a passage that includes the phrase "i really want to be acquitted with you".
I asked to do the same sentiment analysis for another passage.
I provided a passage describing myself as honest, outgoing, and self-confident.
I provided a passage saying I love myself foremost and my family.
I provided a passage saying I love ideas and traveling.
I provided a passage saying I will handle unpleasant aspects of life and still smile.
I provided a passage saying I am generous, kind, and have sympathy for the less fortunate.
I provided a passage saying I am always a peace maker in a world that is "peace less".
I asked to do the same sentiment analysis for the same passage again.
I provided a passage describing myself as appreciating and loving someone’s outspoken honesty.
I provided a passage saying I believe friendships are 100% equal in a relationship.
I provided a passage saying both people should be able to trust each other 100% at all times.
I provided a passage saying any woman who disrespects a man is not a caring woman.
I provided a passage saying I am affectionate.
I provided a passage saying I have no trouble showing affection in public or private.
I provided a passage saying I love to cuddle while watching a good movie.
I provided a passage saying I love to hug, cuddle, and kiss my woman at any time and anywhere.
I provided a passage saying the affection could be in a store, shopping mall, or along the sidewalk.
In the style of the writer, I want to create a heartfelt compliment about someone’s many talents.
I want the compliment without resorting to physical comments.

keyphrases: do not use positive or negative
cuddle while watching a good movie

events.text: Requested sentiment analysis with possible motives on a provided passage
Requested sentiment analysis on a second provided passage
Requested sentiment analysis on the same passage again
Requested sentiment analysis on a third provided passage
Requested creating a heartfelt compliment about talents without physical comments
